verdict.rationale: Docs describe workspace configuration (`.humanlayer/workspace.json`), multi-repo workspace setup that creates task worktrees, and host selection ensuring access to code/tools/credentials — all pointing to automated environment setup. Doc-11 even shows the agent asking about 'setup commands or local files to copy,' implying it can install dependencies, but this is framed as interactive confirmation rather than fully autonomous configuration, and no example shows an end-to-end clone+install+configure flow narrated in one place. Missing for 10: an explicit documented end-to-end example of an agent autonomously cloning, installing dependencies, and configuring environment without human confirmation, plus independent/hands-on corroboration.
